title: Speaking — Teachers and mentors
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on teachers and mentors.

questions: What do you usually do on a Saturday morning?
Do you prefer busy or quiet weekends?
Who do you typically see at weekends?
What will you probably do next weekend?
Do you remember a teacher whose lessons you enjoyed?
Do you ask someone to check your work when you are learning?

part2.topic: Describe a person whose feedback helped you improve.
part2.closing: and explain how your performance changed afterward.

questions: What makes feedback easier for students to act on?
How can workplaces train people to give useful feedback?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to teachers and mentors?
